invariants.why_that_is_the_right_route: SMC-KINEMATIC_BLOCK is the one class whose predicate exact rigid geometry can decide, because the claim is that a path is ABSENT. The other three classes need stability, energy or contact routes this toolset does not have; this design deliberately uses the class it can actually establish. That is a fixture choice, not a statement that the other classes are worse.
